panelIntro: Make a class for each thing you want the computer to tell apart, then take photos of each one.

classes.heading: Classes
classes.deleteBody: Its {{count}} photos go too. The other classes are not affected.
classes.empty: No classes yet. Add two to get started — a classifier needs at least two things to tell apart.
classes.needTwo: Add one more class. The computer can only learn to tell things apart if there are at least two.
classes.duplicate: You already have a class called "{{name}}". Capital letters do not make it different.
classes.tooLong: That name is too long — 40 characters at most.
classes.selectFirst: Choose a class first, so the computer knows what it is looking at.

camera.heading: Camera
camera.burstHint: Press and hold to take a photo every fifth of a second. Move the object around a bit — a model that only ever saw one angle only recognises that angle.

permission.deniedBody: This page is not allowed to use the camera. You can allow it in your browser settings, or upload photos from this device instead — the lab works exactly the same either way.
permission.noDeviceBody: This device does not seem to have a camera. Upload photos instead.
permission.inUseBody: Something else is using the camera — another tab, or a video call. Close it and try again, or upload photos instead.
permission.insecureTitle: The camera needs a secure connection
permission.insecureBody: Cameras only work over https. Ask whoever set this up, or upload photos instead.
permission.unsupportedTitle: This browser cannot use the camera
permission.unsupportedBody: Upload photos instead, or try a different browser.

upload.heading: Or upload photos
upload.hint: You can use photos already on this device. They are read here and never uploaded anywhere.
upload.rejected: {{count}} files were skipped because they are not images.

samples.heading: Photos in {{name}}
samples.empty: No photos in this class yet.

quota.burstStopped: There was no room left, so the photos stopped at {{count}}. Those {{count}} are saved. Delete a project you have finished with to make room for more.
quota.refused: There is no room left on this device for more photos. Delete a project you have finished with first.
